description: This Java class 'SubstitutionStrategyRegistry' serves as a registry for managing multiple manipulation strategies related to placeholders within the system. It encapsulates creation, retrieval, and storage of various 'SubstitutionStrategy' instances used for handling substitution logic based on 'WithDittoHeaders'.

classes.name: SubstitutionStrategyRegistry
classes.description: A final, immutable registry class that maintains a list of 'SubstitutionStrategy' instances, providing methods to instantiate, retrieve matching strategies, and access the list of strategies.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of 'SubstitutionStrategyRegistry', initializing the strategies list.

methods.name: getMatchingStrategy
methods.description: Iterates through stored strategies to find the first one that matches the provided 'WithDittoHeaders', returning it wrapped in an Optional, or an empty Optional if none match.

methods.name: getStrategies
methods.description: Returns the internal immutable list of 'SubstitutionStrategy' instances. This method is intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: createStrategies
methods.description: Private static method that creates and populates a list of various 'SubstitutionStrategy' instances, covering substitutions for policy and ACL subject IDs, as well as broader 'thing' substitutions.
